t: What to say when the greeting is not friendly
a: إِنَّ الْيَهُودَ إِذَا سَلَّمُوا عَلَيْكُمْ يَقُولُ أَحَدُهُمُ السَّامُ عَلَيْكُمْ فَقُلْ عَلَيْكَ
m: When they greet you, say: and upon you. Aisha said: rather, and upon you death and the curse. He said: gently, Aisha. Allah loves gentleness in all matters.
